data.name: MEATBALLS GARDEN
data.detailed_description:
Epilepsy Warning:

This game may contain flashing lights, rapid visual patterns, and other visual effects that may trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

Meatballs Farm is a fast-paced, real-time farming and first-person shooter game.
You play as a farmer and you have only 30 days to pay your debt to the King. Miss the payment, and you’re dead.. Explore a surreal world, take care of your farm, buy items, weapons, and upgrades, kill monsters, and much more.

In this game, you can:

  • Gather resources by obliterating trees, rocks, and other objects

  • Fish a wide variety of fish

  • Take care of plants that resemble human organs

  • Engage in juicy combat with low-poly gore

  • Urinate to water your plants

  • Buy upgrades for both your character and your crops

  • Explore a small, strange, and intentionally surreal world

  • Face random events that force you to think strategically about the next day

I love meatballs.

data.short_description: Meatballs Farm is a fast-paced first-person farming game. Farm, fish, and gather by day. Monsters come at night. You have only 30 days to pay your debt to the King. Miss the payment, and you’re dead.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains light and stylized violence, presented in a low-poly and surreal visual style, with no graphic or realistic depictions. There is no gore or extreme violence. Combat is simple and inspired by classic old-school games such as DOOM (1993).

There is no visible nudity and no explicit sexual content. The game does not include sex scenes or sexual acts. Any references are limited to light-hearted jokes or mild mentions, with nothing graphic or heavy. Some characters may wear suggestive or unconventional clothing, but all characters remain appropriately covered, with no exposure of intimate body parts.

The use of substances such as cigarettes may occasionally be visible. In some cases, characters may make negative or critical comments about such behavior, clearly discouraging or portraying the use in a non-glorified way.

The game does not contain sexual violence, drug or alcohol abuse, or themes of self-harm or suicide.

All content is presented in a moderate, non-realistic, and non-graphic manner, with a focus on gameplay and a retro-inspired aesthetic.
